capture.zh: 完成主线任务《阿洛比斯的哀鸣》后参加活动《黑暗的月影之光》（晚上19-20点）：阿洛比斯每6分钟可挑战一次，最开始100级，之后每次挑战等级下降10级；打败它获得精元。

strategy_notes.zh: 不必第一次就硬拼：每次挑战（输赢都）有10万经验券和B级技能石，阿洛比斯等级逐次降低后再用光、草、水系精灵击败。

engine_notes: level_drops_per_attempt: the first attempt is Lv100; each further attempt the boss is 10 levels lower (100 → 90 → 80 …). The remake keeps a per-save attempt counter for this boss; floor not stated (assume 50).
consolation_reward: every attempt, won or lost, gives 100000 EXP ticket + a B-grade skill stone (item ids are placeholders).
The 4399 page does not explicitly say the win gives a 精元 — the event was the way to obtain 阿洛比斯; essence of the base form 安普 (#1118) assumed, matching other 2012 essence pets.
HP not published (5000 estimate); skills are the species' top learnset skills.
6-minute cooldown and 19-20点 window are real-time limits, dropped.
consolation_reward is dropped in the remake: raising items are unlimited, so the EXP ticket and the skill stone would add nothing (battle/RULES.md 10.3).
source_note: 4399 阿洛比斯 图鉴 page: 活动《黑暗的月影之光》, 每6分钟挑战一次, 100级起每次降10级, 每次得10万经验券+B级技能石.

note.zh: 不管击败还是被击败，每次都得到10万经验券和B级技能石
